from google.cloud import kms

def encrypt_payload(project_id, location_id, key_ring_id, crypto_key_id, plaintext):
    client = kms.KeyManagementServiceClient()
    key_name = client.crypto_key_path(project_id, location_id, key_ring_id, crypto_key_id)
    response = client.encrypt(name=key_name, plaintext=plaintext)
    return response.ciphertext

from google.cloud import kms

def decrypt_payload(project_id, location_id, key_ring_id, crypto_key_id, ciphertext):
    client = kms.KeyManagementServiceClient()
    key_name = client.crypto_key_path(project_id, location_id, key_ring_id, crypto_key_id)
    response = client.decrypt(name=key_name, ciphertext=ciphertext)
    return response.plaintext

from google.cloud import kms

def envelope_encrypt(project_id, location_id, key_ring_id, crypto_key_id, plaintext):
    client = kms.KeyManagementServiceClient()
    key_name = client.crypto_key_path(project_id, location_id, key_ring_id, crypto_key_id)
    response = client.encrypt(name=key_name, plaintext=plaintext)
    ciphertext = response.ciphertext
    # Simulate envelope encryption by encrypting the ciphertext again
    response = client.encrypt(name=key_name, plaintext=ciphertext)
    return response.ciphertext

from google.cloud import kms

def sign_or_verify_key(project_id, location_id, key_ring_id, crypto_key_id, data):
    client = kms.KeyManagementServiceClient()
    key_name = client.crypto_key_path(project_id, location_id, key_ring_id, crypto_key_id)
    response = client.asymmetric_sign(name=key_name, digest=data)
    return response.signature
